result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the second card in 'Popular right now' is missing its restaurant name and metadata, and the bottom navigation bar has a broken black bar overlapping its icons. A few smaller styling inconsistencies were also found.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza image with '-20%' badge) shows only the image — the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, fee and cuisine line that the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has are all absent.
issues.suggestion: Render the title/rating/meta row for every card in the list, or hide cards with incomplete data until the fields load.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar has a thick black horizontal bar running across it, overlapping/obscuring the search and bookmark icons; it looks like a stray divider or mis-sized active indicator rather than intentional styling.
issues.suggestion: Remove or correctly size/position the indicator element so all tab icons are fully visible and unobstructed.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between the two Popular cards: the first has a white/light circular background, the second has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white heart) across all cards.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs have icons only with no text labels, making their purpose ambiguous, and the inactive icons are low-contrast grey.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon and darken inactive icon color to meet contrast guidelines.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light grey on a light grey field, giving weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background.
